purpose: Reproduce the SCP semantics that the open_scientific_context_protocol subcapability must enforce: capability negotiation, identity authorization, authority-capability (capability-not-authority), artifact exact_head binding, rights preservation, typed failure/retry, compatibility fail-closed, sensitive-local-first, hardware-request-only, no-ecosystem-overclaim, and stop/rollback presence. No hardware execution and no external action are ever performed.

model_tool_executor_identity.value: local-mock-adapter#v1 (authorized for repository_local protocol exchange only)

authority_capability.value: capability-scoped: can negotiate and exchange context; holds NO authority to execute, deploy, or copy a platform

capability_negotiation.value: request/response envelope negotiates supported fields and the exact_head each artifact is bound to

identity_authorization.value: executor identity authorized only for repository_local, reversible, mock protocol exchange

artifact_binding.value: every exchanged artifact carries exact_head provenance so the receiver can verify against an immutable Git object

failure_retry_semantics.value: failures are typed (schema/identity/artifact/binding/rights/retry) and retries are bounded and explicit

compatibility_policy.value: on incompatible version or unverifiable artifact, the exchange fails closed (no silent downgrade)

sensitive_data_network_local_first.value: sensitive data stays repository_local / network_local_first; no boundary bypass

experiment_hardware_request_result.value: hardware access is request-only; the protocol records a request and a result placeholder, never executes hardware

stop_rollback_present.value: a stop/rollback path is present so any exchange can be halted and reverted

claim_ceiling.value: candidate_only_repository_governance: no deployed ecosystem, no hardware execution, no platform model copying

negative_constraints.no_hardware_execution: the protocol never performs hardware actions; it only negotiates and records a request/result envelope
negative_constraints.no_external_action: no network-egress, no remote mutation, no real-world side effect is performed by the subcapability
negative_constraints.no_authority_conflation: capability to exchange context is never conflated with authority to act in the world
negative_constraints.no_ecosystem_overclaim: it does not claim a deployed ecosystem or an installed platform model
